lines.t: Verse 1 (female vocal)
I hear Your voice inside the thunder, calling out my name,
Shattering the walls I built to hide my shame.
Your truth, like light, exposes everything I hold —
Yet You reach through the ruin, through the fragments of my soul.
Verse 2 (male vocal)
I’ve been clinging to my shadows, afraid to fall apart,
But You’re tearing down the idols that occupied my heart.
You break me, not to crush me — but to set me free;
To raise me on the Cornerstone You laid for me.
Pre-Chorus (both)
Now I see — what You’ve been doing all along,
Refining through the breaking, turning weakness into song.
Chorus (both)
Break me on the Stone, I will rise in You again.
Let my dust become Your temple, let Your Spirit fill within.
I won’t hide from the fire — let it burn what’s not of You.
Broken, yet unshaken, I am made brand new.
I won’t be crushed beneath the weight of all I’ve done,
Your mercy is the anthem of the risen Son.
Let repentance be the doorway where redemption floods in light —
For every wound You heal becomes a mark of Your might.
Tear down, rebuild, consume, renew —
I fall apart to find You true.
Stone to flesh, breath to bones,
Write Your law in what was my own.
Break me on the Stone, I will rise in You again.
Let my heart be Your reflection — purified, no sin within.
I will stand where mercy reigns, atop the Rock of Truth —
Broken, yet unshaken, I am made brand new.
